meta.name: ponytail-review
meta.description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering. Finds what to delete: reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces it. Use when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we delete", "is this over-engineered", "simplify review", or invokes /ponytail-review. Complements correctness-focused review, this one only hunts complexity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码中过度设计，找出可删除的部分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望消除代码中不必要的复杂性和过度工程
copy.tagline_en: Review code for over-engineering, find what to delete
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to eliminate unnecessary complexity and over-engineering in your code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会专门审查代码中的过度工程,找出可删除的部分,例如重复造的标准库功能、多余依赖、投机性抽象等。每条发现用一行说明位置、删除什么、用什么替代,最后用 net: -N lines 估算可减少的行数。若无需删减,则回复“Lean already. Ship.”。
howto.when: 当你说出“review for over-engineering”、“what can we delete”等短语,或输入 /ponytail-review 命令时触发。说完“stop ponytail-review”或“normal mode”则退出。

say.text: 帮我把这段代码里的过度工程找出来。
say.note: Claude 会列出可删除的部分及替代方案。

say.text: 这个改动是不是有过度设计的地方?
say.note: 会按位置一行一条给出删除建议。

say.text: 检查一下这个 diff 有什么可以删的复杂性?
say.note: 会输出 net: -N lines 估算可减少行数。

howto.what_en: Claude runs code review for over-engineering only. Finds what to delete: reinvented stdlib, unneeded deps, speculative abstractions. One line per finding: location, what to cut, replacement. Final metric: net -N lines. If nothing to cut: 'Lean already. Ship.'
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'review for over-engineering', 'what can we delete', or similar, or invokes /ponytail-review. Exit on 'stop ponytail-review' or 'normal mode'.

say_en.note: Claude lists what to cut and replacements.

say_en.text: What can we delete from these changes?
